title: Secrecy Tracker: Media groups urge von der Leyen to tackle EU secrecy as watchdog probes Gaza documents
lede: Publishers and media organisations, including EUobserver, urge the European Commission to improve transparency as concerns grow over restricted access to EU documents, while secrecy surrounding Gaza funding has been picked up by the EU ombudsman.
